title: Traffic and landing arrangements
placementNote: Pre-July predecessor/background material; chapter coverage must be deliberately decided before publication.

paragraphs.text: Karch told McPartlin Route 1 would close to civilians for 36 hours. The plan set H-hour at 0800 on March 8 and unloading completion at 1600 March 9. These are planned times, not actual completion claims. Companies I and K were to secure the beach; M was reserve.

notes: Source references support the whole proposal; normalized OCR is not a human correction.
